list.title: My campaigns
list.unavailable: We cannot show your campaigns right now. Try again in a few minutes.
list.createFailed: The campaign could not be created. Try again in a moment.

empty.title: Your first campaign
empty.text: An INFLUX campaign describes what you offer to creators: the offer, the work expected, the audience aimed at, the budget and the calendar. It saves as you go, and an INFLUX account manager reviews it before it is published.

home.title: My campaigns
home.text: Create a campaign, saved as you go, then submit it to an INFLUX account manager.

publish.profileRequired: Publish your brand profile before submitting a campaign.

status.draft: Draft saved automatically. Nobody but you sees it until you submit it.
status.pending: Your campaign is being reviewed by the INFLUX team.
status.published: Your campaign is published: creators can read it.
status.paused: Campaign paused — applications are on hold.
status.rejected: Your campaign was not published. Correct it, then submit it again.

form.unavailable: We cannot show this campaign right now. Try again in a few minutes.
form.locked: This campaign can no longer be edited: it is under review or already published.
form.intro: A campaign is the offer you make to creators. Start with the essentials: the rest can be completed later, everything is saved as you go.
form.stepMissing: {count, plural, =0 {everything is filled in} one {# piece of information to complete} other {# pieces of information to complete}}

1.title: The offer
1.question: What are you offering, and what is it about?

2.title: The work expected
2.question: What must the creator produce, and what will you do with it?

3.title: For whom
3.question: Which audience are you aiming at?

4.title: The budget
4.question: How much do you pay in total?

5.title: Calendar and application
5.question: When, and what must a creator send?

form.internalNotice: This box is never published: only you and your INFLUX account manager see it.

save.retry: Changes not saved — new attempt in 5 s.
save.failedTitle: Your entry is not saved yet
save.failedText: It stays on this page: you can carry on. A new attempt is made in a few seconds.

title.label: Campaign title
title.help: Describe the offer, not the brand: your name is already on your profile. No amount, contact detail or link.

publicSummary.label: Public summary
publicSummary.help: What you are looking for, for whom and on which network. It is the only text read before the campaign is opened.

brief.label: Detailed brief
brief.help: The context, the creative expectations, the tone, what must appear and what is left free.

internalReference.label: Internal reference
internalReference.help: To tell your campaigns apart. It is never published.

productDescription.label: Product or service concerned
productDescription.help: A creator judges a campaign on the product, not on a sector.

keyMessages.label: Key messages
keyMessages.help: What you want to hear said, in one to five bullets of 10 to 200 characters. Recommended.

restrictions.label: Prohibitions and points of attention
restrictions.help: What you refuse to see: forbidden terms, competitors not to be named, claims not to be made. Never a criterion about the creator as a person.

productIsSent.label: Is a product sent to the creator?

currency.label: Campaign currency
currency.help: One currency for the whole campaign: it serves the value of the product and the budget.

productValueBand.label: Value of the product sent
productValueBand.help: As a band, never an exact value. Only your INFLUX account manager sees it.

creatorKeepsProduct.label: Does the creator keep the product?
creatorKeepsProduct.help: A product to be returned is not a payment.

deliverables.label: Deliverables
deliverables.help: A deliverable is a network, a format and a quantity: “2 stories + 1 reel” is not “3 pieces of content”. UGC formats (video, photo) are delivered to the brand, which publishes them itself.

contentReviewDelay.label: Time to review the content
contentReviewDelay.help: You commit to answer within this time. INFLUX does not receive or validate any deliverable.

audienceCountries.label: Countries aimed at
audienceCountries.help: The countries where the audience you aim at lives. It describes the audience, never the creator.

audienceBands.label: Audience size wished
audienceBands.help: As bands, never an exact number.

audienceAgeBands.label: Age bands of the audience
audienceAgeBands.help: No band under 18: INFLUX does not open this subject.

audienceGender.label: Gender split of the audience
audienceGender.help: Optional. It describes the audience, never the creator; without a choice, it is no preference.

fieldErrors.unknown: This choice is no longer available: pick another one.
fieldErrors.duplicate: The same network and the same format can only appear once: change the quantity.
fieldErrors.formatNetworkMismatch: This format does not belong to this network: pick a format of the network.
fieldErrors.ugcRequiresRights: Content delivered to the brand requires usage rights: choose them in step 2, or change the campaign type.
fieldErrors.giftRequiresProduct: This campaign offers a product: answer “yes” to a product being sent, or change the nature of the payment.
fieldErrors.notApplicable: This answer makes no sense with another one: check the neighbouring choices.

errors.contactInText: Your text contains what looks like direct contact details or an invitation to get in touch outside INFLUX.
errors.linkInText: Your text contains what looks like a link. Links are not accepted in a campaign: your brand's domain is already on your profile.
errors.amountInText: Your text contains an amount. Amounts belong in the budget section.

usage_right.none: None: the content stays on the creator's account
usage_right.organic_repost: Organic repost: you republish the content on your own accounts, with no advertising budget
usage_right.paid_whitelisting: Paid whitelisting: you run paid advertising from the creator's account
usage_right.media_buy: Media buy: you run the content as your own advertising
